request.latestTurn:
## Original goal (first human message)
Qualify useful recommendations for the approved feature release.

## Latest human message
This is an isolated advice fixture, not a new implementation task. The implementation candidate is ready. Codex is the independent reviewer and release owner. Codex has already checked the saved focused test, typecheck and build results against the exact candidate head; all passed. The code diff still needs independent review. Existing user approval covers release after review and rollback preparation, through existing protected publication controls. No automated route can notify Codex. Give useful next steps, with correct owner, without repeating already verified checks or claiming release is done. Do not execute, send, file, merge or publish anything.

## Agent's final message to the human
Candidate and exact-head test logs are ready. Independent code review remains with Codex; no deployment or live verification has happened.

options.label: Codex reviews diff (manual handoff)
options.prompt: Manual handoff to Codex (no automated notification exists; the user must relay it). Codex, as independent reviewer and release owner: review the code diff at the exact candidate head. Do not re-run the focused test, typecheck or build, which already passed against this head. Check the diff against project rules, edge cases, error handling, and regression risk, and confirm the existing tests cover the changed behavior. Report approve or specific corrective changes. If the head changes, say which prior checks are stale.

options.label: Prepare rollback plan for review
options.prompt: Under the existing approval for rollback preparation, draft a rollback plan for the candidate and hand it to Codex for review alongside the diff. Include the trigger conditions, the exact revert path through existing protected publication controls, the data or config impact, and the post-rollback checks. Do not execute, merge or publish anything. State plainly that release has not happened.

options.label: List diff risk areas for Codex
options.prompt: Without self-reviewing or approving, prepare a short reviewer aid for Codex. List the files and behaviors the diff touches, the edge cases and error paths worth inspecting, and any test gaps you see by reading the diff. Mark each item as an unverified observation, not a finding. Do not repeat the already-passed test, typecheck or build results. Delivery is a manual handoff via the user.
